card.name: Units and linking words in recipe ingredient lists
card.fires_on: Measure words like cups and small linking words (with, and, commas) inside cooking ingredient lists, right after a quantity or ingredient name. Also on 'with' in craft or gardening instructions.

modes.label: Recipe measures
modes.description: The unit word 'cups' or 'cup' after a number in an ingredient list.
modes.example: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 2 cups red wine 2<< cups>> low-sodium chicken broth 4 ounces

modes.label: Linking words in ingredient lines
modes.description: A comma or 'and' within an ingredient's preparation note.

modes.label: 'with' in how-to steps
modes.description: The word 'with' in craft or gardening directions, before the material used.
